steps.en: Individual Owner/Partner details are received from the data source
steps.id: Particulars Owner/Partner individu diterima dari sumber data
steps.why_en: Only an ID and position code arrive, with no name or address, and the job is off in production.
steps.why_id: Hanya ID dan kode jabatan yang datang, tanpa nama atau alamat, dan job-nya mati di production.

steps.en: NOPO is sent back to the 2nd reminder with the Owner/Partner as hirer
steps.id: NOPO dikembalikan ke reminder ke-2 dengan Owner/Partner sebagai hirer
steps.why_en: Nothing changes the notice stage or hirer after the lookup, so no revert happens.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada yang mengubah stage atau hirer notice setelah lookup, jadi revert tidak terjadi.

steps.en: Owner/Partner is recorded as hirer with a mailing address
steps.id: Owner/Partner dicatat sebagai hirer beserta alamat surat
steps.why_en: The lookup never records the person as hirer or saves a mailing address for them.
steps.why_id: Lookup tidak pernah mencatat orang itu sebagai hirer atau menyimpan alamat suratnya.

steps.en: 2nd reminder is made and sent to the Owner/Partner
steps.id: Reminder ke-2 dibuat dan dikirim ke Owner/Partner
steps.why_en: A generic letter run exists, but it would not target this person and file upload is blocked in production.
steps.why_id: Ada pembuatan letter generik, tetapi tidak menuju orang ini dan upload file diblok di production.
